partial-fractions.def: Splitting a rational function whose denominator factors into distinct linear factors into simple fractions: $\frac{p(x)}{(x - a)(x - b)} = \frac{A}{x - a} + \frac{B}{x - b}$ when the top's degree is below the bottom's. Each piece integrates to a natural log, $\int \frac{A}{x - a}\,dx = A\ln|x - a| + C$.
